insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual: 1L to 15L (Standard) and 3L to 50L (Exclusive) | Family Floater: 2L to 15L (Standard) and 3L to 50L (Exclusive) (as per Schedule of Benefits)

great.name: NCB
great.quote: On Renewal of this Policy with the Company without a break, a sum equal to 10% of the Base Sum Insured of the expiring Policy shall be provided as multiplier benefit irrespective of any claims ... The maximum multiplier bonus will not exceed 100% of the Basic Sum Insured in any Policy Year.
great.reference: Section B > 5. Renewal Benefits > 5.1 Cumulative Bonus
great.explanation: You get a 10% increase in Sum Insured at each renewal even if you have made claims, up to 100% of the base Sum Insured. This means your coverage grows regardless of claims, which is better than typical no-claim bonuses that reduce after a claim.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: 30-day waiting period – Code – Excl03 ... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents. This standard waiting period means you are covered for accidents from day one.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Specified disease/procedure waiting period – Code – Excl02 ... excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.
good.reference: Section C > 1(ii) Specified disease/procedure waiting period – Excl02
good.explanation: Certain diseases and procedures are excluded for 24 months from policy start. This is a typical industry standard waiting period.

good.name: PED Waiting
good.quote: Pre-Existing Diseases – Code – Excl01 ... excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from policy start. This is common and not considered a red flag.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization
good.quote: Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses for consultations, investigations and medicines incurred upto 60 days before the date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days before hospital admission are covered. This is a good benefit that helps cover related costs before hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization
good.quote: Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses for consultations, investigations and medicines incurred upto 90 days after discharge from Hospitalisation
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 90 days after hospital discharge are covered. This extended period helps with recovery costs.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: Emergency Air Ambulance Cover ... d(i)The amount payable in case of Air ambulance facility shall be either the actual expenses or Rs. 2.5 Lacs per hospitalization, whichever is lower; upto basic sum insured limit for a year
good.reference: Section B > 2(d) Emergency Air Ambulance Cover
good.explanation: Air ambulance is covered with a limit of ₹2.5 lakhs per hospitalization, where available. This helps in emergencies requiring air transfer.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Annexure I – List I - Items for which coverage is not available in the policy ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 62 OXYGEN MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure I – List I (Items for which coverage is not available)
bad.explanation: Common consumables like gloves and masks are excluded from coverage. This means you may have to pay these costs out of pocket during hospitalization.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: No explicit restore/reinstatement/refill benefit mentioned in provided policy wording text.
bad.reference: Document scan (no restore clause found in Benefits/Renewal sections provided)
bad.explanation: Sum Insured is not replenished after a claim. Multiple hospitalizations in the same year can exhaust your coverage faster.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: This includes • Hospital room rent or boarding; ... (no room rent eligibility/capping stated in the provided extract).
bad.explanation: Room rent eligibility or limits are not stated. If the actual policy has a room rent cap, it can cause proportionate deductions and unexpected out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Maternity Waiting
bad.quote: Schedule of Benefits – Easy Health Individual ... [Waiting Period of 6 years] ... [Waiting Period of 4 Years] ... Schedule of Benefits – Easy Health Family ... [Waiting Period 4 years] ... [Waiting Period of 3 Years]
bad.reference: Schedule of Benefits – Easy Health Individual / Easy Health Family (Maternity Expenses row)
bad.explanation: Maternity waiting periods range from 3 to 6 years depending on plan variant. This long wait delays eligibility for maternity benefits significantly.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-payment means a cost-sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claim amount.
bad.reference: Section A > Standard Definitions > Def. 8 Co-payment
bad.explanation: The policy defines co-pay but does not clearly state if or how much co-pay applies by default. Check the policy schedule for exact cost-sharing terms.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Network Provider means Hospital enlisted by an insurer or a TPA ... to provide medical services to an insured by a cashless facility.
unclear.reference: Section A > Standard Definitions > Def. 30 Network Provider
unclear.explanation: The number of network hospitals is not specified. The size of the cashless network affects how easily you can access cashless treatment.

unclear.name: Modern Treatments
unclear.explanation: The policy extract does not clarify if modern or advanced treatments have sub-limits. Confirm from full policy wording or schedule.

unclear.name: Built-in SI Buffer
unclear.quote: No explicit clause found in provided text for additional SI buffer that activates after base SI is exhausted (e.g., Secure Benefit/Enhanced SI/Super top-up buffer).
unclear.explanation: No separate built-in Sum Insured buffer beyond the renewal bonus is mentioned. Such buffers help extend coverage after the base SI is used up.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
